before: The new real-runtime regression failed because a development-marked source returned HTTP 200 instead of 409 with required scanning enabled

implementation.trust: One shared policy for downloads, PDF previews and worker imports; a development marker is trusted only for APP_ENV=local and SCAN_REQUIRED=false
implementation.inspection: Staging/production inspection fails closed when scanning is disabled
implementation.upgrade: New import of a legacy source verifies its saved size/checksum, scans and structurally inspects the exact bytes, then publishes a new immutable key
implementation.publication: Transaction checks active lease and plan ownership; compare-and-set guards both previous scan status and object key
implementation.failure: Scanner failure never marks the source clean; invalid structure is rejected; checksum mismatch cannot be promoted

verification.mockFailureCoverage: No structural parsing after unavailable/rejecting scanner; successful scanner still requires structural inspection; explicit local development keeps structural inspection without AV
verification.build: Production web and worker Docker images built and started; lint, typecheck and source checks passed
